personalInfo.name: Ibrahim AbuAlhaol
personalInfo.title: AI Technical Lead | PhD, PEng, SMIEEE
personalInfo.motto: Doing something I like, in a place I love, with clean-hearted people.
personalInfo.summary: AI Technical Lead and System Architect bridging the gap between academic research and industrial scale. An inventor with a robust patent portfolio, specializing in architecting Agentic AI, intelligent edge systems, and advanced cybersecurity solutions. Integrates System Engineering and Innovation Management to lead high-performing teams, delivering resilient solutions while empowering the next generation of engineering talent. Committed to ethical AI development and technical mentorship, fostering innovation from research concept to commercial deployment.

education.focus: Specialized in Cybersecurity Architecture and Technology Management. Engineered custom cryptographic algorithms (AES/RSA) for end-to-end encryption services.

education.degree: PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering
education.details: GPA: 4.0/4.0 | Sigma Xi & Phi Kappa Phi Honor Societies
education.focus: Conducted advanced research in wireless systems (MIMO-OFDM). Served as Teaching Assistant for graduate modules on the theoretical foundations of AI: Statistical Analysis, Graph Theory, Coding Theory, and Random Signals.
Designed performance models for secure, multi-rate data transmission in constrained environments (Fast Frequency Hopping CDMA).
Specialized in Telecommunications with a focus on optimizing short-range wireless networks.

experience.description: Spearheads Multi-modal Agentic AI benchmarking initiatives. Architects zero-touch automation by integrating GNN-based Digital Twins and Knowledge Graphs to optimize system reliability and operational efficiency.

Directed the founding of the Data Science department; led the faculty committee to design industry-aligned BSc/MSc curricula and forged strategic partnerships. Represented the department in the multi-agency consortium drafting the Jordan National AI Ethics Charter.
Technical lead for AI-driven cybersecurity solutions. Architected adaptive Deep Learning frameworks for threat detection, fortifying systems against zero-day attacks in real-time log streams.
Designed scalable Decision Support Systems (DSS) aligned with stakeholder requirements. Engineered predictive analytics models and robust data pipelines for logistics optimization.
Led R&D initiatives to architect real-time anomaly detection solutions for large-scale network routing. Designed machine learning models to mitigate IP Prefix Hijacking and DDoS attacks.
Educated and mentored engineering students. Supervised advanced research on Multi-carrier Relay Systems and UAV networks, facilitating projects in Cognitive Radio Networks.
Conducted system-level analysis and optimization of 3G/4G wireless core components in cross-functional engineering environments. Validated RF/RX front-end performance.
